/** CRC-64 ISO, compatible with Go hash/crc64. BigInt is used only at the API boundary. */
import { updateNativeCrc64 } from '../crc64-native.ts';
const HI = new Uint32Array(256);
const LO = new Uint32Array(256);
// Prototype controls: profiling flag, elapsed milliseconds, byte count, native backend.
export const CRC_PROFILE = new Float64Array(4);
for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
  let hi = 0, lo = i;
  for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
    const carry = lo & 1;
    lo = ((lo >>> 1) | ((hi & 1) << 31)) >>> 0;
    hi >>>= 1;
    if (carry) hi = (hi ^ 0xd8000000) >>> 0;
  }
  HI[i] = hi;
  LO[i] = lo;
}

export class Crc64 {
  private hi = 0xffffffff;
  private lo = 0xffffffff;
  private native = false;
  private nativeState = new Uint8Array(8);

  constructor() {
    this.native = CRC_PROFILE[3] === 1;
    this.nativeState.fill(255);
  }

  update(buf: Uint8Array): void {
    const started = CRC_PROFILE[0] ? performance.now() : 0;
    if (this.native) {
      updateNativeCrc64(this.nativeState, buf);
    } else {
      let hi = this.hi, lo = this.lo;
      for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
        const t = (lo ^ buf[i]) & 0xff;
        const nextLo = ((lo >>> 8) | (hi << 24)) >>> 0;
        hi = (HI[t] ^ (hi >>> 8)) >>> 0;
        lo = (LO[t] ^ nextLo) >>> 0;
      }
      this.hi = hi;
      this.lo = lo;
    }
    if (CRC_PROFILE[0]) {
      CRC_PROFILE[1] += performance.now() - started;
      CRC_PROFILE[2] += buf.length;
    }
  }

  reset(): void {
    this.hi = 0xffffffff;
    this.lo = 0xffffffff;
    this.nativeState.fill(255);
  }

  sum64(): bigint {
    if (this.native) {
      const s = this.nativeState;
      const hi = (s[0] << 24 | s[1] << 16 | s[2] << 8 | s[3]) >>> 0;
      const lo = (s[4] << 24 | s[5] << 16 | s[6] << 8 | s[7]) >>> 0;
      return (BigInt((hi ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0) << 32n) | BigInt((lo ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0);
    }
    return (BigInt((this.hi ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0) << 32n) |
      BigInt((this.lo ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0);
  }
}

export function crc64ISO(buf: Uint8Array): bigint {
  const h = new Crc64();
  h.update(buf);
  return h.sum64();
}
